spool_dir.description: Root directory for HylaFAX spool data (jobs, status, etc.)

config_dir.description: Directory containing static configuration files and templates

var_dir.description: Base path for variable data; used to resolve relative paths like /var/spool

system_id.description: Human-readable identifier for this fax server (e.g., 'OfficeFax1'); leave blank for auto-detect

country_code.description: International dialing prefix (e.g., 1 for US/Canada, 44 for UK)

area_code.description: Default area code for outbound calls (used when fax number is local-only)

fax_number.description: Primary fax number (e.g., '+14155551234'); required for sending

time_zone.description: Time zone string (e.g., 'US/Eastern', 'Europe/London'); used for timestamps

modems.description: List of modem devices to use; each entry defines a physical or virtual modem

device.description: Path to the modem device node (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/ttyS1)

speed.description: Baud rate for modem communication (e.g., 57600, 115200); optional, auto-detected if omitted

receive_threads.description: Number of concurrent threads listening for incoming faxes (increase for multi-line setups)

send_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent outgoing fax jobs

max_msg_size.description: Maximum incoming fax size in KB (10240 = 10 MB); larger faxes are rejected

caller_id.description: Enable caller ID extraction for inbound calls (requires compatible modem)

t30_auto_negotiate.description: Automatically negotiate T.30 parameters (e.g., V.27ter, V.29, V.34) with remote fax

t30_parameters.description: Comma-separated T.30 capability list for negotiation; usually left as default

pagers.description: Email/HTTP endpoints to notify on fax receipt or error; supports multiple destinations

destination.description: Email address or HTTP URL for pager notification

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for pager acknowledgment (default 30)

access_rules.description: IP-based access control list; processed in order (first match wins)

action.description: Whether to allow or deny traffic from this network

network.description: IPv4 or IPv6 network in CIDR notation (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8')

admin_util.description: Path to the HylaFAX administration utility

sendmail.description: Path to a sendmail-compatible MTA binary (e.g., Postfix, Exim)

verbose_logging.description: Log every fax step (e.g., modems signals, protocol events); useful for debugging

page_size.description: Default paper size for outgoing faxes (e.g., 'letter', 'a4', 'legal')

resolution.description: Fax resolution in dots per inch (e.g., '98x98' for fine, '196x196' for standard)

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts per failed outbound fax job

retry_time.description: Minutes to wait before retrying a failed send (min 1, typical 5–15)

compression.description: Enable T.6/T.4 compression (recommended for faster transmission)

page_margin.description: White margin around fax content (in 1/100 inch); prevents clipping at page edges

t38_enable.description: Enable T.38 fax-over-IP (replaces voice channel with UDP data stream)

t38_udp_port.description: UDP port to listen on for T.38 sessions (if enabled)

dialout_enable.description: Allow outbound fax dialing; disable to make server receive-only

auto_answer.description: Enable automatic answering of incoming calls (required for receive mode)

answer_delay.description: Seconds to wait after ring before picking up (adjust for multi-ring lines)
